proposed_changes.before: Sandhills Energy solar project (in development since 2019, construction reportedly started February 2026, ~$15M invested/$100M in equipment orders per company representative Brian Boerner) was initially covered by the moratorium as adopted, then later exempted after the company threatened litigation.
proposed_changes.after: Butler County Solar/Sandhills Energy: April 6, 2026 official county minutes record approval of project-specific exemption Resolution 2026-11, with six ayes, no nays and Sypal absent. Any road agreement was described as a separate issue. The standalone executed exemption text, precise project footprint and any conditions remain unverified.

proposed_changes.before: A nine-month countywide moratorium covering wind, solar, data centers, battery storage and landfills was adopted March 16, 2026, subject to earlier completion and adoption of the county zoning regulations and comprehensive plan. Earlier Flatwater Free Press reporting attributed a later exemption for an in-progress solar project; the exemption instrument has not been independently established.
proposed_changes.after: The original March 16 nine-month moratorium remains subject to its earlier-ending condition. On April 6, Krafka moved and Coufal seconded approval of Resolution 2026-11; Krafka, Vandenberg, Coufal, Griess, Bauer and Steager voted aye, with Sypal absent, and the motion carried. The minutes describe an exemption for Butler County Solar/Sandhills Energy, not a general exemption for all solar projects. Later county adoption, operative termination and current force remain unverified.
